interpretation: FAST DR2 does not select a unique MIGHTEE correction or reconcile all three catalogues. Do not apply the old ALFALFA-derived correction to all 47 objects.

paired_descriptive_post_result_diagnosti.disclosure: Computed after primary result; descriptive only; no cuts or primary decision changed

independent_check.implementation: stdlib csv, Cartesian cross/dot angular separation, statistics.median; no imported analysis code
independent_check.scope: Independently verifies candidate pairs, one-to-one matching, reliable-sample membership, per-source flux conversion and median ratios. Does not independently validate bootstraps or confusion filtering.

remaining_limitations: Only 21 of 47 original science galaxies match, 15 reliable and 14 clean; three beyond the release redshift limit
